title: Shadow KV growth regression: containment, triage, and gradual rollback plan
creator: Leah Moreno
description: During a traffic surge on 2026-02-27 we observed sustained memory growth on several inference hosts caused by a previously-unseen interaction between the prefetch writepath and the async compaction job. Shadow/ghost KV entries accumulated in the prefix cache namespace and were not reclaimed, triggering large eviction storms and increasing tail latencies. This ticket tracks containment, a hotfix rollout, and a safe rollback/mitigation plan plus follow-up engineering work to prevent recurrence.
impact_summary: Peak impact: 12 hosts with >1.6x memory growth over 3 hours, 8% increase in 99th percentile token latency, and a 6% uptick in user-facing generation errors during the surge window. No customer data exposure. Some Dedicated customers experienced degraded throughput and were routed to fallbacks by smart routing policies.
incident_root_cause: A regression in the prefetch path added a tombstone marker for prefetched prefixes under high-eviction pressure. The tombstone combined with a compaction async race prevented normal reclamation and left shadow entries whose refcounts were never decremented. The eviction heuristics then mis-prioritized these entries causing eviction amplification rather than memory reclaim.
reproduction_steps: 1) Start a cluster with prefixcache prefetch enabled and async compaction set to aggressive (compaction_interval=30s).
2) Replay a production-like traffic trace with bursty long-context requests that trigger prefetch for adjacent prefixes.
3) Simultaneously trigger a simulated low-memory condition on one shard to force eviction scoring churn.
4) Observe shadow entries accumulating in metrics: kvcache.shadow_entries and refcount_nonzero_after_free.
5) Confirm memory growth and increased eviction_retries metric.
Note: we provide a reproducible harness in the runtime e2e repo linked below.
timeline: 2026-02-27 02:10 UTC - On-call alerted by PagerDuty: memory growth on inference pool us-west-2-infer-2.
2026-02-27 02:22 UTC - Triage: increased prefixcache.shadow_entries and eviction_retries; routing moved traffic to fallback pool.
2026-02-27 02:35 UTC - Emergency mitigations: throttled prefetching, increased compaction frequency, and triggered manual scrub job.
2026-02-27 03:15 UTC - Memory growth plateaued on most hosts after scrub; partial customer impact persisted.
2026-02-27 08:00 UTC - Hotfix PR created and validated in canary cluster (hotfix reverted faulty tombstone write).
2026-02-27 12:30 UTC - Hotfix rolled to remaining clusters with staged rollback for older servers.
2026-02-28 09:00 UTC - Post-incident review started; initial root cause identified.
2026-03-01 10:00 UTC - This ticket created to track remediation and long-term fixes.
mitigations_applied: Temporarily disabled speculative prefetch for high-cardinality tenants (feature flag).
Launched one-off scrub job to rewrite shadow entries and decrement reference counters safely.
Increased compaction pass frequency for affected clusters to reduce tombstone window.
Activated smart routing fallbacks for impacted Dedicated tenants to preserve SLAs.
short_term_action_items: ENG-756412-A1: Patch writepath so prefetch tombstones are annotated with namespace and refcount guard (Akash) - TARGET 2026-03-05.
ENG-756412-A2: Add an automated scrub job to background maintenance that detects & safely rewrites shadow entries (Sandeep) - TARGET 2026-03-07.
ENG-756412-A3: Add emergency feature flag to disable prefetch per-tenant (Leah) - DONE 2026-02-27.
ENG-756412-A4: Hotfix rollout to canary then staged rollout to clusters with rollback window of 2 hours (Akash, Ops) - DONE 2026-02-27.
ENG-756412-A5: Communicate mitigations and status to affected customers and CS reps (Emily, CS) - DONE.
long_term_action_items: Improve eviction scoring to incorporate tombstone age and origin channel to avoid mis-prioritization (owner: storage team) - ESTIMATE 8.
Fix async compaction race: ensure compaction observes and clears refcounts atomically with a lock-free handshake (owner: infra) - ESTIMATE 13.
Expand CI fuzzing on writepath/compaction interactions to include high-concurrency prefetch + eviction scenarios (owner: SRE) - ESTIMATE 5.
Add telemetry and alerts for refcount drift and shadow entry growth at tenant-level; create runbook thresholds (owner: observability) - ESTIMATE 3.
Include a regression test in the release gating checklist that replays the production trace used to surface this bug (owner: QA) - ESTIMATE 2.
Quarterly audit of prefetch heuristics and a safety limit for speculative writes per tenant (owner: product/platform) - ESTIMATE 3.
telemetry_changes: New counter: kvcache.shadow_entries_by_tenant (tagged by tenant_id, region).
New gauge: kvcache.refcount_orphans - alert when > 50 on a host for > 10m.
Dashboard: prefixcache health panel with compaction_latency, tombstone_age_p50/p90, eviction_retries, and prefetch_write_rate.
Alert: page when shadow_entries_growth_rate > 10% / 15m AND memory_growth_rate > 5% / 15m.
rollout_and_risk_mitigation: Canary first: single availability zone with traffic slice and enhanced telemetry collection for 2 hours.
Staged rollout with safety window and automated rollback if refcount_orphans increases by > 10% in 30m.
If rollback triggered, disable prefetch feature flag globally and run scrub job before reattempting rollout.
Perform a capacity soak on smallest Dedicated pools prior to global rollout to validate no regression under sustained load.
